name: Problems Colecionador
summary: Problems Colecionador is an online competitive puzzle game inspired by the classic Mahjong Solitaire. Players must quickly match tiles to complete columns and clear the board in fast-paced 1v1 online matches against opponents worldwide. Winning matches allows players to climb the global rankings and unlock avatars featuring their favorite characters from the 'Turma do Problems'.
